title: Travels: Jazz Limited, New York, Cuba, Canada
summary: He worked five months at Jazz Limited and travelled to Cuba, Canada and Montreal with various leaders.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: They made those in New York too, I guess, on one of their trips. Did you ever get to New York and Chicago much?
Well, I worked at the Jazz Limited about five months.
Oh, that's right. I remember you told me.
Yeah. I played in New York quite a bit. Lee Allen, rock and roll band, anything. I've been all over Bill, but California.
I stayed down in Cuba six weeks with Joe Rubischoff. Well I stayed eight weeks in Canada with Paul. I stayed four weeks in Montreal with Lee Allen. I've been around.
